title: Remove public agent update script
body:
## Summary
- remove the publicly served `/update.sh` agent updater
- direct agent updates through the existing authenticated control-plane work-item flow
- correct the documented target-version behavior and manual binary path
- align the update dialog's security wording with the actual authenticated channel

## Verification
- `git diff --check`
- confirmed no remaining `update.sh` references
- reviewed with Groky: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019f92ef-10e3-7115-818a-26c36f8678ad

No runtime tests were added because this removes a static shell asset and updates documentation/UI copy; the existing self-update implementation is unchanged.
